title: Init generator options
description: Bootstrap the workspace with a sample api-spec + api-lib pair, wired up and ready to run out of the box.

skipBootstrap.description: Only ensure @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli is installed, without scaffolding the sample api-spec/api-lib pair. Always set when init runs internally as part of the api-spec/api-lib generators.

apiSpecName.description: Name of the sample api-spec lib to bootstrap

apiLibName.description: Name of the sample api-lib to bootstrap

client.description: A framework preset for the bootstrapped api-lib. Use "custom" to generate a plain typescript-fetch client with no framework dependency.

useDockerBuild.description: Have the bootstrapped api-lib run the generator inside a Docker container instead of via npx
